admission.justification: A truthful state word and complete hover prevent the row from presenting inferred non-reporting lifecycle assumptions or omitted facts as an actual task event; the retired outside-attention priority is not promised.

applicability: The single task-state word and full hover of an Operations task row.
conditions: Server TaskEntry stage/activity own the word and mark; browser colour and elapsed silence do not infer state.
Need ordering uses each entry own works/started/planned/terminal band.
Hover uses served entry/content/count facts without lifecycle or worktree-status reconstruction.

A limited, started task with none of its agents working shows `rate limited: <time left>` in one compact unit with paused's tone, and the hover names each limited seat with its provider, its exhausted window and the exact reset including date and time zone.
A place with no display clock shows `rate limited` and puts the reset in its hover and its accessible name.
exclusions: Deriving task stage or activity from UI colour, elapsed silence or a retired lifecycle event.
Operational severity dots, process phases, dependency readiness and verdict vocabulary are distinct domains.

evidence: dashboard/src/panels/lifecycle-list/rowState.test.ts: "says the most pressing fact as the one word"; dashboard/src/panels/lifecycle-list/signals.test.tsx (8 tests); dashboard/src/panels/lifecycle-list/admission.test.tsx: "renders ONE task entry per enclosureId: a bound lifecycle annotates the doc row, never duplicates it".

statement: An Operations row formats its own served task stage and started-task activity through the common status word and mark; need bands order works, other started, planned and terminal tasks. Its hover presents title, unauthored-document notice, state/stage, repository, current step, progress, host event and abandoned/discarded counts when present, not removed lifecycle/worktree reports or an unrendered scope/reference path A limited task keeps that same row: its word becomes `rate limited: <time left>` in one compact unit with paused's tone, and its hover retains every BASE field while adding each limited seat's provider, exhausted window and exact reset.
